title: An in situ engineered azo-linked conjugated polymer anode enabling ultra-stable, high-energy aqueous alkaline batteries at −60 °C
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1282-1295
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06874F, Paper
Mengxiao Li, Yu Li, Huijie Wang, Mingjun Hu, Jun Yang
We developed an azo-linked conjugated polymer anode via an in situ electrochemical synthesis strategy, which provides a sustainable and cost-effective alternative for large-scale energy storage by avoiding toxic heavy metals or expensive alloys.
